user.title: New kid panel
user.description: Name the panel. Choose what it shows and controls afterwards, under Configure.

init.title: Panel contents
init.description: Panel address (treat it like a password): {url}

data.regenerate_key: Generate a new address (the old link stops working)

data_description.control_entities: Lights, switches, fans, blinds and other covers, media players, scenes and scripts the panel may operate.
data_description.view_entities: Shown with their current value. Nothing here can be changed from the panel.
data_description.display_names: One per line, as entity_id: Name

error.unsupported_domain: Only lights, switches, fans, covers, input booleans, media players, scenes and scripts can be controlled.

send_link.name: Send panel link
send_link.description: Sends a panel's address to a device through a notify action, so the key never has to be copied by hand.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: The panel whose address to send.

notify_service.name: Notify action
notify_service.description: Name of the notify action that reaches the device, without the notify. prefix (e.g. mobile_app_alex_phone).

create_pairing_code.name: Create pairing code
create_pairing_code.description: Makes a 6-digit code, valid once for 10 minutes, that a device (the watch app, or a browser at /kid_panel/pair) trades for the panel's address. The code is also shown in Home Assistant's notifications.

panel.name: Panel
panel.description: The panel to pair a device with.
